MOBILE TOUCH CONTROLS

On mobile devices, tap ⚡ ABILITY on the bottom-left of the screen, and use 🦘 JUMP & directional arrows on the bottom-right!

🪐 CIRCULAR ORBITAL GRAVITY
Gravity always pulls towards the planet center. Rotating platforms align dynamically to your orbital position!
⚡ AIR DASH SMASH
Dashing with Volt Dash, Chrono God, or Aegis Blaster allows you to smash directly through Shadow Drones!
🌌 SHADOW VOID PURSUIT
The Shadow Void wall creeps counter-clockwise behind you. Use Void Blast abilities to push it back up to 180°!
